items.title: John E. Wood Interview, 1986-06-26
items.q: I guess in Hogan probably had said something to me sometime about you.

ctx.x: Yeah, well, I mean, to me this is interesting because I've never talked to many people about this. How did we get to know each other?

You and I? Yeah. Through just being in this history department at Tulane. I guess in Hogan probably had said something to me sometime about you. And I probably hunted you up and said, listen, you know, I hear you're interested in the music. And I am too. Where do I go to get to hear something? And you were forthcoming and said, well, you know, come to a parade. There's going to be some things. And then I remember very well, you were very regular. You would call up maybe Friday afternoon or something and say, you…
I was a graduate student around 56, yeah.
